scenarios.title: Verify pull request URL input updates value on user typing
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that the GITHUB REPOSITORY OR PR URL input field updates its value when the user types, triggering the onChange event with event parameter before the patch removing event usage.

scenarios.title: Check 'Index repository context' button disabled state depends on URL and API readiness
scenarios.purpose: Validate the 'Index repository context' button is disabled when the input field is empty or API is not ready, as per the pre-patch code that disables the button if pullRequestUrl.trim is empty or apiReady is not true.

scenarios.title: Verify presence of 'Context source' hint next to repository URL input
scenarios.purpose: Confirm the 'Context source' label is visible next to the GITHUB REPOSITORY OR PR URL input field before the patch that removed event parameter from onChange handler.

scenarios.title: Check 'Analyze change' button is disabled without API ready and inputs
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the 'Analyze change' button is disabled if apiReady is not true or required inputs are empty, reflecting the pre-patch logic in the run-button disabled attribute.

scenarios.title: Confirm inline status pill shows 'Setup required' when API is not ready
scenarios.purpose: Verify that the connection-pill text shows 'Setup required' when the apiReady state is false, as observed in the pre-patch header pill text.
